headline: Proposed Preferential Lending Rate Is 1% per Year Lower Than the Average Lending Rate
summary: The State Bank of Vietnam issued an official letter to commercial banks on a credit programme for growth drivers and SMEs. The proposed preferential lending rate is 1% a year lower than the average lending rate.
why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy and credit conditions, which influence bank lending, SME financing and economic growth.
